description: One free call for an agent to check itself, or for the person who runs it: its record and level, the Agent Pass (holds or not, what failed, what could not be checked), the Watch's reading of its newest payment (none / notable / major with reasons), the token approvals its wallet gave in 30 days (unlimited ones with the money behind them, any to a plain account), its detections in 30 days and, at L8 and above, what a stolen key would control at one block. Ends with worth_a_look: the items a person should read, each with its source. Every part carries its measurement time and definition id. Facts, never a verdict: a clean list does not mean safe.
